The book of Hebrews refers to the altar as a symbol of Christ's sacrifice, linking the tabernacle's sacrificial service to the new covenant.
The description of the entrance to the tabernacle (פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד) where the altar was placed.
